data.one_liner: Display country flags in SVG format with offline support.
data.what_it_does: Provides optimized SVG country flags that can be easily displayed using country codes. It works offline and includes helper lists for valid country codes and names.
use_when: You need to display country flags in a Flutter application.
You want an offline-capable flag rendering solution using SVG format.
avoid_when: You need complex geographic mapping tools rather than just static country flags.
strengths: Works completely offline without requiring internet access for flags.
Lightweight and optimized SVG loading across multiple platforms.
weaknesses: Limited functionality beyond displaying flags and providing code-to-name lookups.
